node.statement: Let C=conv{p_w : w in W} and d_i=dist_1(p_i,C). Because W is nonempty and v is a hidden top vertex of height H, d_v=H and 0<=d_i<=H for every row i. Finite-dimensional l1 separation at p_v gives an affine functional phi with phi(p_v)=H, phi(x)<=dist_1(x,C) for all x, and linear part of l_infty norm at most 1.
